apps.name: BetterBMS
apps.subtitle: JBD / CyberCase BLE BMS
apps.localizedDescription:
BetterBMS talks to JBD (Xiaoxiang) BLE BMS boards such as CyberCase. Live telemetry, MOSFET control, EEPROM parameters, and pack-tuned limits for 4S6P Molicel P45B.

Sign and install with Feather using your own certificate.

versions.localizedDescription: Unlock works offline (saves PIN). Autofill remembered PIN. Forget BMS pairing on Mine.
Stop connect/PIN/scan loop. Stable PIN field on Scan for fresh install. No fake ZL 000000 auth.
Hide MOS software lock from protections/trips — expected after app FET on/off, not a fault.
Fix PIN sheet open/close spam when live data is already flowing. Sheet only auto-prompts if telemetry never arrives.
Protection trip counts: each flag counts up on inactive→active (shown in Real Time sheet + Parameter). MOS software lock explained. Polls BMS 0xAA error counters.
Gauge shows Output live (never Idle) when Discharge MOS is on; hardened discharge MOS OFF when FET stayed on after ACK.
Status shows Standby (not Idle) when Discharge MOS is on at ~0 A; Output off when discharge FET is off.
Tappable Real Time MOS pills; full protections tap sheet; Last command reports undervoltage when it blocks discharge ON; no fake OK (0xe1).

appPermissions.bluetooth: Connects to your BMS over Bluetooth Low Energy.

news.title: 1.3.9 — Output live + MOS off
news.caption: Must show 1.3.9 in Mine. Output live when pack can power devices; stronger discharge MOS off.
